The root cause is that `src/checkout.js` called `flagsmith.identify(user.email)` just before `trackEvent("purchase")`, so purchases were logged under the email identity instead of the user ID that was bucketed into the experiment, which is why every variant shows 0 conversions.

I removed the re-identify call in `src/checkout.js`, so the purchase event now goes out under the original identity. I haven't run it, and the Flagsmith skill failed to load, so I worked from `evidence.json` and the code alone.

The evidence supports this: the warehouse has received 4,210 events, but both variants show 0 conversions. If billing needs the email, send it as a trait or event property instead of changing the identity.

The saved experiment config also lists only a "green" variant, with no explicit control. I left that alone, since it's a Flagsmith-side setting and not part of the code fix.
